english: But Jīmūtavāhana’s wife, Malayavatī, looked towards the heavens, and in accents choked with tears thus reproached the goddess Ambikā, who before was pleased with her, and granted her a boon: “At that time, O goddess Gaurī, thou didst promise me that I should have for husband one destined to be paramount sovereign over all the kings of the Vidyā-dharas, so how comes it that thou hast falsified thy promise to me?” When she said this, Gaurī became visible, and saying, “Daughter, my speech was not false,” she quickly sprinkled Jīmūtavāhana with nectar from her pitcher.[14] That made the successful hero Jīmūtavāhana at once rise up more splendid than before, with all his limbs free from wounds.
